items.title: split: TOCTOU output-open allows truncating a swapped file
items.summary: split checks input/output identity by path before opening the output, then opens with truncation, leaving a race window on mutable path components. GNU opens first and compares the opened output inode against the input before truncating. The race can cause split to truncate/write a file different from the one validated — including the input file or another file the process can access. Fixed in 0.10.0 (PR 12565,…
